subject: Procurement gating checklist & latency/SLA clarifications
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@medisys.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-07T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement gating checklist & latency/SLA clarifications

Alex — thanks for the time earlier today. Short recap and specific asks so we can keep momentum: 

Summary from the call:
- Primary business objective: accelerate retrieval pipelines for clinical decision support (Medisys PoC) while keeping PHI controls and predictable unit economics.
- Decision criteria you called out: end-to-end latency (p95), data residency / PHI handling, SLA floor, and total cost of ownership.

What I heard as targets (please correct):
- Latency: p95 target ~150–200ms (you said 150ms is ideal)
- Deployment: preference for VPC/private deployment due to PHI, but open to Redwood Dedicated if there are cost or operational tradeoffs
- SLA: target 99.95% uptime and an on-call escalation window for production incidents
- Commercial: cost-sensitive — need a ballpark monthly range to take to procurement

Concrete asks / next steps: 
1) Please confirm the economic buyer and procurement contact (name + email) so I can loop them in.
2) Share the procurement checklist you use for vendor evaluation (security, legal, contract timeline).
3) We will provide an initial SOW draft and a SOC2 summary for your security team — attaching both here.
4) If you confirm p95 target and PHI requirement, Jasmine will schedule a 30-min architecture call to scope hosting and model sizing.

Attachments (stubs):
- SOC2-Summary.pdf (2-page summary)
- SOW_Draft_20260907.docx (initial commercial + scope)

If you can reply with the econ buyer + procurement email and your preferred times for a 30-min technical alignment next week, I’ll get calendars out.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@medisys.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medisys.ai, Ellen Park <ellen.park@medisys.ai>
Date: 2026-09-07T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement gating checklist & latency/SLA clarifications

Thanks Marcus — quick answers from our side. Good recap.

Stakeholders (internal):
- Economic buyer: Dr. Priya Raman (VP Product) — priya.raman@medisys.ai
- Procurement: procurement@medisys.ai (primary contact: contracts team)
- Security/Privacy lead: Ellen Park <ellen.park@medisys.ai>

Requirements / clarifications:
- PHI: we must have a signed BAA; all processing must be in a US-region (preferably us-east).
- Deployment: VPC (customer VPC with private link) is preferred for production. Dedicated hosting is acceptable if it meets BAA and residency constraints.
- Latency: target p95 ~150ms end-to-end for the primary inference path. Can tolerate 200ms in non-critical workflows.
- SLA: 99.95% with defined credits and an escalation tree for Sev 1 incidents.
- Budgeting: rough monthly budget range is $25k–$40k depending on whether we go private (higher) or dedicated (mid).
- Timeline: procurement review by 2026-09-30; decision target by 2026-10-15.

Attached is our standard procurement checklist (high level) to help you map legal and security docs we’ll need. Please send a short pricing range and any timeline requirements for a BAA/legal review.

Attachment: initial_procurement_checklist.xlsx

Happy to jump on the architecture call next week — available Wed 09/09 09:00–11:00 PT or Thu 09/10 13:00–15:00 PT.

—Alex
Alex Chen
Director of Integrations | Medisys Health
alex.chen@medisys.ai
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-08T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement gating checklist & latency/SLA clarifications

Looping in a short technical note based on Alex’s reply. Quoting the key requirements and next actions.

Quoted: 
> "Lat ency: target p95 ~150ms end-to-end ... Deployment: VPC (customer VPC with private link) preferred ... PHI: must have a signed BAA"

Feasibility / immediate asks: 
- Feasible options: Dedicated cluster with 4x A10G equivalent GPUs + optimized batching should hit p95 ~120–160ms for the model family they described. Private (customer VPC) is also feasible but requires an ops window for network handoff and initial install (~2–3 weeks).
- Model/quantization tradeoff: if Medisys will accept 8-bit quantization for the primary model, CPU & memory footprint drops and private deployment cost reduces ~25%. We should flag any quality regression tests.

Internal action items (proposed):
1) Naomi: prepare HIPAA/BAA checklist + include SOC2 artifact references — target EOD 2026-09-09.
2) Marcus: share econ buyer + procurement contact (Marcus to confirm) and send the SOW/pricing range to procurement.
3) Jasmine (me): schedule a 30-min architecture deep-dive with Alex, Ellen (security), and procurement; propose Wed 09/09 09:00 PT or Thu 09/10 13:00 PT.
4) Engineering follow-up: create ENG-1462 ticket to validate network requirements and private install checklist (link below).

Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-1462

I’ll draft the technical appendix for the SOW after the deep-dive so legal has concrete hosting wording.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Procurement gating checklist & latency/SLA clarifications

We’ll do the following: 
- Naomi will assemble the HIPAA/BAA mapping + SOC2 artifacts and send to procurement by end of day tomorrow.
- Jasmine will run the architecture deep-dive to confirm resource sizing and the private install checklist.
- I will produce a short pricing band and an updated SOW that calls out the hosting options and estimated timelines.

Proposed times for the 30-min technical call (please confirm one):
- Wed 2026-09-09 09:00 PT (preferred)
- Thu 2026-09-10 13:00 PT

If those don’t work, tell me a couple slots and we’ll adapt. I’ve attached the SOW draft and our SOC2 summary again for procurement/legal review.
